Fix What Conform Can Fix

Source: R/rProject-conform-fix.R
ConformFix.Rd

Applies the fix rows of Conform(): it writes the missing tier 1 template files and the files every package has (from reference when it has them, else from rProject), and removes the strays (main.tex, an empty .tmp-r/) from the working copy. It never overwrites a file, and never touches a decide or info row. Strays are removed only with remove = TRUE, and never a locked copy. The upload folder is compared with the project (files that differ, that are missing, and that are not in the manifest) and the drift is reported. Then it keeps the records in step: it adds a "Structure audit additions" section to the log .setup/logs/YYYY-MM-DD-<topic>.md (made with Log() when there is none; a fix-up with FixUp() when the log was already pushed, that is, a row of .setup/logs/index.md names it with a commit), and puts the new files and the log in the upload folder (in place when the log was not pushed, a -fixup folder when it was). It prints the files changed and the files to delete in Overleaf (which it never does itself), and that the dot-files must be created by hand in Overleaf. With lint = TRUE or tests = TRUE it ends with a final re-check: the real make lint and the unit tests, reported as in Conform() (never run otherwise). Nothing is committed or pushed.

Usage

ConformFix(
  path = ".",
  reference = NULL,
  topic = "conform",
  dest = NULL,
  remove = FALSE,
  lint = FALSE,
  tests = FALSE,
  log_dir = tempdir()
)

Arguments

path

Character string. The project folder.

reference

Character string or NULL. The folder of a finished project to compare the file set with. With NULL, only the manifest and the rules are used.

topic

Character string. The topic of the change-set log (.setup/logs/YYYY-MM-DD-<topic>.md).

dest

Character string or NULL. The folder that holds the upload folders, as in Upload().

remove

Logical. If TRUE, remove the strays (main.tex, an empty .tmp-r/) from the working copy; otherwise they are only reported. A locked copy (a file in .setup/r-dependencies/<lib>/ or .setup/cpp/) is never removed.

lint, tests

Logical. If TRUE, run make lint or devtools::test() after the fixes, as in Conform().

log_dir

Character string. The folder for the raw outputs of the final re-check.

Value

Returns a list, invisibly, with the files written (new), the files to delete in Overleaf (overleaf), the local-only removals (local), the log, and the upload folder (NULL when there was nothing to fix), and check, the findings of the final re-check (NULL without lint or tests).

Author

Ivan Jacob Agaloos Pesigan

Examples

if (FALSE) { # \dontrun{
ConformFix(path = getwd(), reference = "../devel-linearAlgebra")
} # }
